source.lemmas: Authored for icanspeak Italian in standard Italian (variety it-IT; "regional" notes where daily life differs by region), chosen by topic for CEFR B2, with what a resident of Italy needs first. Level banding is our own, NOT the Nuovo Vocabolario di Base (De Mauro) and no exam list (CILS, CELI, PLIDA, CERT.IT): the UI must not claim otherwise. gender = singular definite article as the learner says it: il / lo / la / l' (il/la for common-gender person nouns; genus m|f with l'). The plural article is derived (src/lib/articles.js). IPA authored (broad standard Italian, open/closed e and o marked).
